primary_outcome: acid-base status, pulmonary gas exchange, muscle oxygenation during incremental exercise
effect_direction_evidence: The V˙E was significantly lower in HCP versus placebo, but HCP did not affect the gas exchange status of V˙CO2 or oxygen uptake (V˙O2).

primary_outcome: muscle performance, lactate response, and delayed onset muscle soreness
effect_direction_evidence: an acute intermittent HRW hydration improved muscle function, reduced the lactate response, and alleviated delayed onset of muscle soreness.

primary_outcome: peripheral blood lymphocyte subsets (immune function)
effect_direction_evidence: These results show that high-flow hydrogen inhalation has an inhibitory effect on the immune function of healthy participants.

primary_outcome: skin oiliness, moisture, and pH in acne vulgaris patients
effect_direction_evidence: The level of sebum decreased and moisture levels increased during hydrogen purification. Topical hydrogen purification is an effective and safe treatment for acne vulgaris.

primary_outcome: heart rate variability (autonomic cardiac regulation)
effect_direction_evidence: After administration of HRW, we found significantly increased ratio Ln SDNN/RMSSD when comparing it to placebo in 25 min (HRW: 0.40 ± 0.30, placebo: 0.26 ± 0.25, p = .049)

primary_outcome: radiation-induced bone marrow damage (WBC and platelet counts)
effect_direction_evidence: H2 gas treatment significantly alleviates the reducing effects of white blood cells and platelets (P = 0.0011 and P = 0.0275, respectively).

primary_outcome: heat-retention effects assessed by thermography post-bathing
tear stability and dry eye symptoms
effect_direction_evidence: H2 significantly and safely improved tear stability and dry eye symptoms in a small exploratory group of 10 human subjects

primary_outcome: angina symptoms and serum lipid levels in unstable angina patients
effect_direction_evidence: Clinical analysis showed hydrogen-rich water intake relieved angina symptoms in unstable angina patients.

primary_outcome: delayed cerebral ischemia and cerebral vasospasm
effect_direction_evidence: Incidences of cerebral vasospasm and delayed cerebral ischemia were significantly higher in the control group than in other groups.

primary_outcome: UPDRS scores
effect_direction_evidence: the UPDRS scores began significantly decreasing from the first week, and this improvement persisted until the end of therapy.

population_condition: acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD)
primary_outcome: change from baseline in BCSS score at day 7
effect_direction_evidence: Change of BCSS score in Hydrogen/oxygen group was larger than that in Oxygen group (− 5.3 vs. − 2.4 point; difference: − 2.75 [95% CI − 3.27 to − 2.22], meeting criteria for superiority).

primary_outcome: overall survival in lung cancer patients treated with nivolumab
effect_direction_evidence: The 42 patients treated with hydrogen gas and nivolumab (HGN) indicated a significantly longer overall survival (OS) compared with those treated with nivolumab only (n=14).

primary_outcome: fasting blood glucose, fructosamine, 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol, urinary 8-OHdG
effect_direction_evidence: The subjects exhibited significant tendencies for the decreased fasting blood glucose and fructosamine, and for the increased 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol, concomitantly with significant decreases in urinary 8-hydroxy-2-deoxyguanosine contents

primary_outcome: 4.2-km up-hill race time
effect_direction_evidence: HRW for the 4 slowest runners (RT = 1490 [91] s) likely improved the RT (-36 to -3 s), whereas for the 4 fastest runners (RT = 1069 [53] s) the performance effect of HRW was unclear (-10 to 26 s).

primary_outcome: gastritis severity and miRNA expression (miR-7, miR-155, miR-135b, miR-29c)
effect_direction_evidence: Endoscopic findings of gastritis were such different (less severe disease), P = 0.024; in 43% diagnosed with moderate gastritis upfront esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) presented mild gastritis after the consumption of alkaline water

primary_outcome: lymphocyte subset immunosenescence indexes
effect_direction_evidence: After 2 weeks of hydrogen therapy, the number of exhausted and senescent cytotoxic T cells decreased to within the normal range, and there was an increase in killer Vδ1 cells.

primary_outcome: diacron-reactive oxygen metabolites (d-ROMs) and biological antioxidant potential
effect_direction_evidence: d-ROMs levels significantly decreased at 8 weeks in ERW compared to those in MW.

primary_outcome: blood total antioxidant capacity (BAP/d-ROMs ratio)
effect_direction_evidence: HW suppressed the reduction in biological antioxidant potential/diacron-reactive oxygen metabolites observed in PW.

primary_outcome: breath acetone levels during submaximal exercise
effect_direction_evidence: H2 significantly augmented breath acetone and enhanced oxygen uptake during exercise (P < 0.01).

primary_outcome: peak oxygen uptake during incremental cycling exercise
effect_direction_evidence: the 2-week continuous consumption of HW significantly augmented peak oxygen uptake and tended to increase the peak load without any significant changes in lactate levels, oxidative stress, and antioxidant responses.

h2_concentration_raw: 7 ppm of H2: 3.5 mg H2 in 500-mL water
primary_outcome: Ln_RHI (reactive hyperemia index via peripheral arterial tonometry)
effect_direction_evidence: Ln_RHI improved by 22.2% (p<0.05) at 24 h after the first ingestion of high H2 water and by 25.4% (p<0.05) after the daily consumption of high H2 water for 2 weeks.

primary_outcome: body fluid balance and exercise performance (TTE)
effect_direction_evidence: TTE did not significantly differ between the trials.

primary_outcome: ankle swelling, range of motion, single-leg balance
effect_direction_evidence: HRW was equivalent to RICE protocol to reduce ankle swelling (2.1 ± 0.9% vs. 1.6 ± 0.8%; P = 0.26), range of motion (2.4 ± 1.3 cm vs. 2.7 ± 0.8 cm; P = 0.60)

primary_outcome: pain VAS score at 24-hour follow-up
effect_direction_evidence: The pain VAS self-completed by the patient dropped from 50 points (moderate pain) at baseline (immediately after injury) to 20 points (mild pain) at 24-h follow-up.

population_condition: moderate to severe persistent allergic rhinitis
primary_outcome: nasal nitric oxide (nNO) concentration
effect_direction_evidence: The difference of nNO test values before and after treatment of the two lavage fluids was statistically significant（P<0.01）.

primary_outcome: cognitive function (MMSE and ADAS-Cog scores)
skin density change after 4 weeks
effect_direction_evidence: The skin densities of the participants in the experimental group and the control group increased by 18.41% and 9.93% after 4 weeks, respectively.

primary_outcome: blood cholesterol, glucose, HbA1c, inflammation, redox biomarkers
effect_direction_evidence: Supplementation with high-concentration HRW significantly reduced blood cholesterol and glucose levels, attenuated serum hemoglobin A1c, and improved biomarkers of inflammation and redox homeostasis as compared to placebo (P < 0.05).

primary_outcome: progression-free survival and pulmonary symptom prevalence
effect_direction_evidence: progression-free survival of the control group was lower than that of the H2-only group, and significantly lower than that of H2 + chemotherapy, H2 + targeted therapy, and H2 + immunotherapy groups.

primary_outcome: LAC, LDH, CPK levels after resistance exercise
effect_direction_evidence: The decrease of LAC and LDH values in the HRW group compared with the placebo were significant. However, the changes of CPK was not significant in neither of the experience.

primary_outcome: running time to exhaustion during incremental treadmill test
effect_direction_evidence: No statistical difference was observed in running time to exhaustion (618 ± 126 vs. 619 ± 113 s)

primary_outcome: objective response rate in cGVHD patients
effect_direction_evidence: Of the 24 patients, 18 (75%; 95% CI, 55.1% to 88%) had an objective response.

primary_outcome: oxidative stress and immune function in peripheral blood cells
oxidative stress markers and cytokines
effect_direction_evidence: Oxidative stress was reduced and cytokine levels were unchanged in cardiogenic patients, whereas oxidative stress was unchanged and cytokine levels were diminished in the septic patient.

primary_outcome: dissolved hydrogen concentration and ORP dependencies on water properties
serum creatine kinase and biomarkers of muscular damage at 24h
effect_direction_evidence: A single-session bathing in HRW prevented a rise in circulating biomarkers of muscular damage induced by exercise at 24-hour follow-up, retaining the levels of all biomarkers similar to the baseline values

primary_outcome: airway inflammation markers in peripheral blood and EBC
effect_direction_evidence: A single inhalation of hydrogen for 45 min attenuated inflammatory status in airways in patients with asthma and COPD.

primary_outcome: VAS-estimated alertness in sleep-deprived adults
effect_direction_evidence: no differences were found between interventions (treatment vs. time interaction) for all evaluated outcomes of alertness (P > 0.05), with the effects similar among interventions.

primary_outcome: progression-free survival and overall survival
effect_direction_evidence: hydrogen gas decreased the abundance of exhausted terminal PD‑1+ CD8+ T cells, increased that of active terminal PD‑1‑ CD8+ T cells, and improved PFS and OS times

primary_outcome: skin blotch and visceral fat area changes
effect_direction_evidence: the visceral fat area decreased from 47 to 36 cm[2], and the abdominal circumference decreased from 91 to 82 cm, in the two female subjects bathing in hydrogen-water.

primary_outcome: serum Alzheimer's biomarkers (Aβ40, Aβ42, tau), cytokines, ROS, NO
effect_direction_evidence: We found that HW treatment significantly decreased the serum level of Aβ 40 after 6 mon of treatment.

primary_outcome: blood lactate, ventilatory equivalent for O2, RPE during incremental exercise
effect_direction_evidence: A significantly lower blood lactate was found with HRW (4.0±1.6 and 8.9±2.2 mmol.l-1) compared to Placebo (5.1±1.9 and 10.6±3.0 mmol.l-1) at 3.0, and 4.0 W.kg-1, respectively.

population_condition: non-small cell lung cancer with multiple metastases
primary_outcome: brain metastasis size and disappearance
effect_direction_evidence: After 1 year, all brain tumors had disappeared, and there were no significant changes in metastases in the liver and lung.

primary_outcome: tumor response (pseudo-progressive remission) after hydrogen inhalation
effect_direction_evidence: the metastases in the abdominal cavity gradually decreased in size, anemia and hypoalbuminemia were corrected, and both the lymphocyte and tumor marker levels returned to normal.

primary_outcome: tumor size reduction and clinical status in metastatic gallbladder cancer
effect_direction_evidence: Three months after hydrogen therapy, the metastases in the abdominal cavity gradually reduced in size, her anemia and hypoalbuminemia were corrected, lymphocyte and tumor marker levels returned to normal

population_condition: stage III and IV advanced cancer
primary_outcome: quality of life, disease control rate, tumor markers
effect_direction_evidence: 41.5% of patients had improved physical status, with the best effect achieved in lung cancer patients and the poorest in patients with pancreatic and gynecologic cancers.

primary_outcome: radiation-induced bone marrow damage (WBC, PLT, RBC, HGB, HT)
effect_direction_evidence: H2 gas treatment significantly alleviates reducing effects of WBC and PLT respectively.

primary_outcome: urinary 8-OHdG levels
effect_direction_evidence: it did increase urinary 8-OHdG levels by 16%

primary_outcome: reduction rate of corneal endothelial cell density
effect_direction_evidence: These rates were significantly smaller in the H2 group at all time points.

primary_outcome: SCAT2 score at 24-hour follow-up
running time-to-exhaustion in incremental maximal test
effect_direction_evidence: Breathing 4% hydrogen for 20 min per day resulted in increased peak running velocity (by up to 4.2%) as compared to air inhalation (P = 0.05).

primary_outcome: liver fat accumulation measured by dual-echo MRI
effect_direction_evidence: Dual-echo MRI revealed that HRW significantly reduced liver fat accumulation in individual liver regions-of-interest at 28-day follow-up, as compared to placebo administration (P < 0.05).

primary_outcome: submaximal exercise HR and RR during graded treadmill test
effect_direction_evidence: HRW significantly decreased average exercising RR and HR (p < 0.05).

primary_outcome: psychometric fatigue (VAS) and endurance (VO2max)
effect_direction_evidence: Endurance and fatigue were significantly improved in the H2 group as judged by maximal oxygen consumption and Borg's scale, respectively.

primary_outcome: peak expiratory flow rate
effect_direction_evidence: The combination of alkaline water and asthma-induced gymnastics effectively and significantly improves the peak expiratory flow rate values at the Day 8 (p = 0.039) and the Day 14 (p = 0.012).

primary_outcome: antioxidant activity and gut flora diversity in soccer players
effect_direction_evidence: the consumption of hydrogen-rich water for two months significantly reduced serum malondialdehyde, interleukin-1, interleukin-6, tumour necrosis factor-α levels; then significantly increased serum superoxide dismutase, total antioxidant capacity levels and haemoglobin levels

primary_outcome: gastrointestinal symptoms and general health
effect_direction_evidence: Sufficiently clear effect could not be confirmed. But the stools were more normal, and, as shown in the previous report, that drinking AEW is considered to contribute to intestinal normalization.

population_condition: pemphigus vulgaris with infected skin ulcers
primary_outcome: treatment of skin ulcers infected with conditional pathogenic strains
effect_direction_evidence: We are the first to report on a new, safe, and effective treatment of infections induced by conditional pathogenic strains with local wet packing with hydrogen water.

primary_outcome: proportion of terminal PD-1+ CD8+ T cells and survival outcomes
effect_direction_evidence: 14 patients treated with a combined therapy of hydrogen gas and nivolumab showed a significantly longer OS than the remaining 12 patients who were treated with nivolumab alone.

primary_outcome: acid-base balance, hydration status, and anaerobic capacity
effect_direction_evidence: The results indicate that drinking alkalized water enhances hydration, improves acid-base balance and anaerobic exercise performance.

primary_outcome: peak power output during repeated sprints
oxidative/nitrosative stress markers and GERD symptom scores
effect_direction_evidence: combination treatment with PPI and ERW improves the cellular redox state leading to the improvement of the quality of life as demonstrated by the correlation analysis between laboratory parameters and GERD symptoms.

primary_outcome: symptoms and signs score, treatment index, total effective rate
effect_direction_evidence: There were significant differences of the symptoms, signs scores, the treatment index, the total efficiency and BQLQ between the two kinds of lavage fluid used for patients before and after treatment(P<0.05).

primary_outcome: muscle soreness (VAS), neutrophil dynamics, muscle damage markers
effect_direction_evidence: Conversely, there were no effects of H2 bath.

primary_outcome: change in body fat percentage from baseline to 4 weeks
effect_direction_evidence: H2 treatment significantly reduced body fat percentage (3.2 vs. 0.9%, P = 0.05) and arm fat index (9.7 vs. 6.0%, P = 0.01) compared to placebo administration, respectively.

primary_outcome: anaerobic performance and acid-base balance
effect_direction_evidence: The results of the specific anaerobic endurance test revealed a significant difference in performance between the tests performed after hydrating with highly alkaline water in comparison to table water.

primary_outcome: mood, anxiety, autonomic nerve function (K6 score, sympathetic activity)
effect_direction_evidence: Change ratios (post-treatment/pre-treatment) for K6 score and sympathetic nerve activity during the resting state were significantly lower after HRW administration than after PLW administration.

primary_outcome: composite of all-cause mortality and non-lethal cardio-cerebrovascular events
effect_direction_evidence: Multivariate analysis of the Cox proportional hazards model revealed E-HD as an independent significant factor for the primary endpoint (hazard ratio 0.59; [95% confidence interval: 0.38-0.92])

primary_outcome: peritoneal membrane preservation (mesothelial cells, thickness)
effect_direction_evidence: Histological study revealed a significant increase in the number of mesothelial cells and a significant decrease in peritoneal thickness in the H2-PD group as compared to the control and PD groups.

primary_outcome: ADAS-cog score after 1 year
effect_direction_evidence: although there was no significant difference between the H2- and control groups in ADAS-cog score after 1 year, carriers of the apolipoprotein E4 (APOE4) genotype in the H2-group were improved significantly on total ADAS-cog score

primary_outcome: IBS symptom improvement rate over 8 weeks
effect_direction_evidence: Eight patients (61.5%) in the ARW group and six patients (42.9%) in the control group indicated that their symptoms had improved in more than four out of the eight weeks of treatment (p = 0.449).

primary_outcome: 8-oxo-dG and MDA levels after exercise-induced oxidative stress
effect_direction_evidence: In the test group, its levels at each time were significantly lower than that in the peak level.

primary_outcome: keratin plug cleansing and capillary blood stream in healthy subjects
effect_direction_evidence: After hydrogen warm water bathing, the numbers of cleansed keratin plugs also increased on cheek of subjects 2.30- to 4.47-fold as many as the control for normal warm water.

primary_outcome: Change in total UPDRS score from baseline to 72nd week
inspiratory effort via diaphragm electromyography (EMGdi)
PASI score improvement at week 8
effect_direction_evidence: 24.4% of patients (10/41) receiving hydrogen-water bathing achieved at least 75% improvement in Psoriasis Area Severity Index (PASI) score compared with 2.9% of patients (1/34) of the control group (Pc = 0.022)

primary_outcome: cardiac salvage index at 7 days after primary PCI
effect_direction_evidence: the cardiac salvage index as evaluated using cardiac magnetic resonance imaging at 7 days after primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), showed no significant between-group difference (HI: 50.0±24.3%; control: 60.1±20.1%; P=0.43)

primary_outcome: streptococcal biofilm formation inhibition
effect_direction_evidence: Our data showed that H-water caused a significant decrease in in vitro streptococcal biofilm formation.

primary_outcome: blood condition / redox potential effects on human blood
effect_direction_evidence: The powerful antioxidant effect of hydrogen-saturated water is indicated. Blood state close to ideal is observed after consumption of natural mineral medical-table hydrogen-saturated water «Polyana Kvasova».

primary_outcome: breath H2 concentration after consumption of H2-producing milk
effect_direction_evidence: The total range of H2 production (area under the curve) increased and a higher peak concentration was observed compared with consumption of H2 water or pure cows' milk.

primary_outcome: clinical profiles incl. anti-hypertensive use, fatigue, pruritus
effect_direction_evidence: Multivariate analysis revealed E-HD was an independent significant factor for the reduced use of anti-hypertensive agents as well as the absence of severe fatigue and pruritus at 12 months after adjusting for confounding factors.

primary_outcome: MRI signal intensity, NIHSS scores, Barthel Index
effect_direction_evidence: The following significant effects were found: the relative signal intensity of MRI, which indicated the severity of the infarction site, NIHSS scores for clinically quantifying stroke severity, and physical therapy evaluation, as judged by the Barthel Index.

primary_outcome: random blood sugar levels
effect_direction_evidence: there is a significant difference in the level of random blood sugar of diabetes mellitus type 2 performed by using four kinds of intervention of alkaline water treatment

primary_outcome: serum superoxide anions, SOD activity, total antioxidant capacity
effect_direction_evidence: The serum superoxide anions, serum SOD activities, and total antioxidant capacities of athletes during and after training were significantly superior to those of the control group (P<0.05)

primary_outcome: serum antioxidant enzymes (SOD, glutathione, catalase, GPx) and MDA
effect_direction_evidence: Hydrogen-rich water intervention significantly improved serum activities of superoxide dismutase and glutathione as compared to the placebo (P < 0.05), while no differences were observed between groups for changes in catalase and glutathione peroxidase

primary_outcome: liver function (ALT, AST, ALP, IBIL, direct bilirubin) after mFOLFOX6
effect_direction_evidence: The hydrogen-rich water group exhibited no significant differences in liver function before and after treatment, whereas the placebo group exhibited significantly elevated levels of ALT, AST and IBIL.

primary_outcome: post-exercise blood pH and lactates
effect_direction_evidence: Hydrogen-rich water significantly affected post-exercise blood pH and lactates as compared to the placebo (P < 0.05)

primary_outcome: FeNO, lung function, inflammatory and oxidative stress markers
effect_direction_evidence: Inhalation of hydrogen gas could alleviate airway inflammation and oxidative stress of sanitation workers exposed to air pollution.

primary_outcome: ROS in blood (FORT test)
effect_direction_evidence: ROS was showed lower tendency in HW group than PW group after drinking, and especially lowest tendency in a minute (p<0.01) and 5 minutes (p<0.05).

primary_outcome: exercise-induced oxidative stress and delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS)
effect_direction_evidence: Weekly hydrogen bathing had no effects of exercise-induced oxidative stress and muscle damage. On the other hand, hydrogen bathing significantly reduced DOMS (VAS) 1 and 2days after downhill running (p=0.033).

primary_outcome: fraction of human mercaptalbumin (f(HMA)) pre- and post-HD
effect_direction_evidence: The f(HMA) of EWHD2015 significantly increased from EWHD2014 on both pre- and post-HD (pre, 51.32 ± 5.63 % → 58.03 ± 7.43 %; post, 72.04 ± 5.73 % → 76.42 ± 4.67 %).

primary_outcome: treatment response in chronic graft-versus-host-disease
effect_direction_evidence: we report a patient with severe chronic graft-versus-host-disease successfully treated by drinking hydrogen rich water which may be a safe and effective method for chronic graft-versus-host-disease.

primary_outcome: feasibility and safety of hydrogen gas inhalation in PCAS patients
effect_direction_evidence: No undesirable effects attributable to HI were observed and 4 patients survived 90 days with a favorable neurological outcome.

primary_outcome: blood viscosity at high and low shear rates after exercise-induced dehydration
effect_direction_evidence: consumption of the electrolyzed, high-pH water reduced high-shear viscosity by an average of 6.30% compared to 3.36% with standard purified water (p = 0.03).

primary_outcome: serum NSE, IL-6, and TNF-α levels
effect_direction_evidence: After treatment, these levels in the hydrogen water group were lower than those in the conventional group.

primary_outcome: change in total UPDRS score from baseline to 72nd week
probing pocket depth and clinical attachment level
DAS28 and PASI score changes during H2 treatment
effect_direction_evidence: The DAS28 and PASI score of the three patients decreased during H2 treatment, regardless of the administration method. The psoriatic skin lesions almost disappeared at the end of the treatment.

primary_outcome: HDL function and lipoprotein composition in hypercholesterolemia
effect_direction_evidence: HDL isolated from H2 group showed an increased ability to promote ATP-binding cassette transporter A1 (ABCA1)-mediated cholesterol efflux ex vivo.

primary_outcome: peripheral blood IL-1β mRNA expression after acarbose
effect_direction_evidence: The induction of hydrogen gas production and the reduction in peripheral blood IL-1β mRNA after the test meal were not significant between days 1 (without acarbose) and 2 (with acarbose).

primary_outcome: DAS28 disease activity score in 28 joints
effect_direction_evidence: In the H2-infused group, average DAS28 decreased from 5.18 ± 1.16 to 4.02 ± 1.25 immediately post infusion and reached 3.74 ± 1.22 after 4 weeks.

primary_outcome: arterial blood pH at baseline and post-exercise
effect_direction_evidence: Intake of HRW significantly increased fasting arterial blood pH by 0.04 (95% confidence interval; 0.01 - 0.08; p < 0.001), and postexercise pH by 0.07 (95% confidence interval; 0.01 - 0.10; p = 0.03)

primary_outcome: plasma viscosity and limb swelling after musculotendinous injury
effect_direction_evidence: HYD intervention augmented the decrease in plasma viscosity as compared to the CON (20.7 ± 2.4 vs. 15.4 ± 1.9%; p = 0.002).

primary_outcome: biochemical markers of inflammation and functional recovery
effect_direction_evidence: oral and topical hydrogen intervention resulted in a faster return to normal joint range of motion for both flexion and extension of the injured limb as compared with the control intervention (P < 0.05)

h2_concentration_raw: 7 ppm H2 (3.5 mg H2 in 500 mL water)
primary_outcome: flow-mediated dilation (FMD) of the brachial artery
effect_direction_evidence: The ratio to the baseline in the changes of FMD showed significant improvement (P<0.05) in the high-H2 group compared to the placebo group.

primary_outcome: albumin redox state as marker of oxidative stress
effect_direction_evidence: the mean proportion of reversibly oxidized albumin in outlet serum was significantly lower than that in inlet serum following the H2‐HD session

primary_outcome: wound healing / pressure ulcer recovery in hospitalized elderly patients
effect_direction_evidence: PU hospitalized days in EG were significantly shorter than in LG (113.3 days vs. 155.4 days, p < 0.05), and the shortening rate was approximately 28.1%.

primary_outcome: patient-reported symptoms (ICSI, ICPI, PUF, VAS pain, voiding diary)
effect_direction_evidence: the effect of hydrogen-rich water on symptoms was not significantly different from that of placebo

primary_outcome: safety/complications of IV H2-enriched solution in acute ischemic stroke
effect_direction_evidence: Data from the current study indicate that an H2-enriched intravenous solution is safe for patients with acute cerebral infarction, including patients treated with t-PA.

primary_outcome: UV-induced erythema, DNA damage, and inflammatory gene expression in skin
effect_direction_evidence: H(H2O)m application to human skin prevented UV-induced erythema and DNA damage. And H(H2O)m significantly prevented UV-induced MMP-1, COX-2, IL-6 and IL-1β mRNA expressions in human skin in vivo.

primary_outcome: serum LDL-cholesterol levels and HDL function
effect_direction_evidence: consumption of H2-rich water for 10 weeks resulted in decreased serum total-cholesterol (TC) and low-density lipoprotein-cholesterol (LDL-C) levels.

primary_outcome: albumin redox state (reduced albumin fraction) in effluent and blood
effect_direction_evidence: Mean proportion of reduced albumin (ƒ(HMA)) in effluent was significantly higher in H2-enriched dialysate (62.31 ± 11.10%) than in standard dialysate (54.70 ± 13.08%).

primary_outcome: oxidative stress markers in serum
effect_direction_evidence: the oxidative stress remained unchanged in routine treatment group, but markedly improved in hydrogen treatment group.

primary_outcome: Total UPDRS score change over 48 weeks
blood lactate levels and muscle peak torque during acute exercise
effect_direction_evidence: oral intake of HW prevented an elevation of blood lactate during heavy exercise. Peak torque of PW significantly decreased during maximal isokinetic knee extension, suggesting muscle fatigue, but peak torque of HW didn't decrease at early phase.

primary_outcome: urinary 8-OHdG and disease activity (DAS28)
effect_direction_evidence: Urinary 8-OHdG was significantly reduced by 14.3% (p < 0.01) on average. DAS28 also decreased from 3.83 to 3.02 (p < 0.01) during the same period.

primary_outcome: wrinkle formation and skin damage under UVA irradiation
effect_direction_evidence: HW-bathing significantly improved wrinkle in four subjects on the back of neck on 90th day as compared to 0 day.

primary_outcome: serum MDA, TNFα, IL-6, relA protein, iNOS/COX2/IL-6 mRNA post-exercise
effect_direction_evidence: 2 weeks of ionized alkali water supplement suppressed increases in serum MDA, PBMC relA (p65) protein, and PBMC COX2 mRNA expression induced by the acute and exhaustive treadmill exercise

primary_outcome: blood hydrogen concentration and physiological safety parameters
effect_direction_evidence: Physiological parameters on these 3 patients were essentially unchanged by use of hydrogen.

h2_concentration_raw: H2 concentration measured by gas chromatography
population_condition: acute erythematous skin diseases with fever and/or pain
primary_outcome: improvement of erythema and associated symptoms
effect_direction_evidence: Erythema of these 4 patients and associated symptoms improved significantly after the H2 treatment and did not recur.

population_condition: mitochondrial myopathies, polymyositis/dermatomyositis, progressive muscular dystrophy
primary_outcome: serum parameters and urinary 8-isoprostane; lactate-to-pyruvate ratios
effect_direction_evidence: a significant improvement was detected in lactate in MM. Lactate-to-pyruvate ratios in MM and MMP3 in DM also exhibited favorable responses but without statistical significance.

primary_outcome: quality of life (QLQ-C30 global health status) during radiotherapy
effect_direction_evidence: QOL scores during radiotherapy were significantly improved in patients treated with hydrogen-rich water compared to patients receiving placebo water.

primary_outcome: MRI indices (rDWI & rADC) in acute brainstem infarction
effect_direction_evidence: The initial hump of rDWI reached 2.0 in the E group which was better than 2.5 of the natural course but was not as good as 1.5 of the EH group.

primary_outcome: blood lactate accumulation and time to exhaustion during exercise
effect_direction_evidence: Blood lactate sampled at velocity 8.1 mph during the test was significantly lower in the NORP group (p < 0.05).

population_condition: end-stage renal disease with chronic haemodialysis
primary_outcome: T-cell apoptosis and surface markers in HD patients after ERW dialysate
effect_direction_evidence: After a 1-year ERW treatment, the patients had a decrease in T-cell apoptosis and increases in CD3(+), CD4(+) and CD8(+) cell numbers and CD25/CD69/CD94/CD3(+) phenotypes in the T cells.

primary_outcome: antioxidant status (SOD, TBARS) in metabolic syndrome subjects
effect_direction_evidence: The consumption of hydrogen rich water for 8 weeks resulted in a 39% increase (p<0.05) in antioxidant enzyme superoxide dismutase (SOD) and a 43% decrease (p<0.05) in thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS) in urine.

primary_outcome: inflammatory markers and blood pressure control in haemodialysis patients
effect_direction_evidence: significant decreases in levels of plasma monocyte chemoattractant protein 1 (P < 0.01) and myeloperoxidase (P < 0.05) were identified.

primary_outcome: blood glucose, plasma triglycerol, total cholesterol levels
effect_direction_evidence: resulted in significant improvement of impaired blood sugar, plasma triglycerol and total cholesterol levels (P<0.05)
device_maker: Hita Tenryousui (Nakanoshima, Hita city, Oita, Japan)

primary_outcome: PMN viability and clinical feasibility of electrolyzed water in HD
effect_direction_evidence: Basal cellular viability and function to generate superoxide radicals of PMNs were better preserved by e-RO application.

primary_outcome: HbA1c and blood sugar levels in diabetes patients
effect_direction_evidence: One hundred and eighty six tested persons or 45% of the total have been assigned to the responder group, meaning that the patients' HbA1c and blood sugar improved significantly.

population_condition: type 2 diabetes mellitus or impaired glucose tolerance
primary_outcome: lipid and glucose metabolism biomarkers including modified LDL, small dense LDL, urinary 8-isoprostanes
improvement of diabetes-relevant test parameters after drinking Nordenau water
effect_direction_evidence: The clinical test of 356 diabetes patients drinking Nordenau water in Germany resulted in the improvement of the relevant tests parameters after 6 days

primary_outcome: blood sugar and HbA1c changes in diabetes patients
effect_direction_evidence: Two hundred and thirty six tested persons that is to say (73.8%) had been assigned to the responder group and 84 (26.2%) to non-responder.

primary_outcome: blood oxidative stress biomarker levels
